It does not claim issue 149 acceptance, issue 120 acceptance, CC00 acceptance or CC01-CC05 adoption.

derivation.note: The R6B review prose is not in this checkout and was not fetched (no network). The five items are taken from the captured acceptance list; anything the prose says beyond those strings is not claimed here.

claims.r6bItem: private journal readback 독립 관측의 이름/schema와 판정 입력을 분리한다.
claims.mechanism: The journal readback is named and versioned as an independent observation (ObservationName='private-journal-readback', ObservationSchema='chooguard.private-journal-observation/1', payload under 'Readback'). judgment_input() derives a separate document (JudgmentInputName='load-causal-judgment-input', JudgmentInputSchema='chooguard.load-causal-judgment-input/1') that references the observation and carries only declared judgment fields; validate_judgment_input() refuses a judgment input that embeds the private readback. read_journal() keeps its previous return shape so run_simulation_probe.py is unaffected.

judgmentInput.name: load-causal-judgment-input
judgmentInput.disjointness: judgment input keys ∩ observation-only keys = {} observed at runtime

normalSiblings.proves: the declared observation yields a judgment input whose keys embed no readback key

negativeCases.selects: an observation that renames its own schema to the judgment-input schema
an observation carrying an undeclared top-level key (the raw State) alongside Readback
a judgment input that embeds the private readback State

claims.r6bItem: expected_kind exact variant와 grouped command_marker_P_fault dispatch가 동일 사례를 선택한다.
claims.mechanism: One canonical fault-case table in foundation_load_metrics: EXACT_FAULT_VARIANTS maps the metrics exact variant (expected_kind) to a canonical case id and GROUPED_FAULT_MARKERS maps the player-log grouped marker to the same ids. dispatch_fault_case() resolves either selector; assert_fault_dispatch_agreement() requires a one-to-one, two-way agreement and is called at FaultLogReader construction, so the run refuses to start on a divergence. FaultLogReader.MARKERS is derived from the shared table and poll() returns the canonical case id (or None), raising PLAYER_FAULT_LOG_DISPATCH_AMBIGUOUS when two cases match one line, so the grouped dispatch is a function of the observation rather than an any() of substrings. A metrics fault row declaring an unknown variant is refused as FAULT_KIND_UNKNOWN.

normalSiblings.selects: the runner log reader over a real private log file
every declared case through both selectors
a metrics Kind=fault row with FaultKind

negativeCases.selects: a grouped marker naming a case with no exact variant
one log line matching two canonical cases
a metrics fault row declaring an unregistered exact variant

claims.r6bItem: legacy MetricsReader의 server/client role 및 잘못된 role 부정시험을 명시한다.
claims.mechanism: ROLE_VALUES = ('server','client') is the declared role domain. MetricsReader.__post_init__ refuses any other role as INVALID_READER_ROLE, and Interval.parse separates INVALID_EXPECTED_ROLE (the caller asked for a role that does not exist) from ROLE_MISMATCH (a row produced for the other role). The legacy reader is therefore explicit about which role it sums instead of rejecting an unknown role with the wrong code.

normalSiblings.selects: a server row read by a server reader
a client row read by a client reader

negativeCases.selects: a client row handed to a server reader
a server row handed to a client reader

claims.r6bItem: cleanup_begin local deadline 누락을 CLEANUP_BEGIN 참조로 표현한다.
claims.mechanism: run() captures cleanup_begin = clock() before the blocking manager.close() and records result['CleanupBegin'] = {ObservedSeconds, LocalDeadlineSeconds, WithinLocalDeadline} with LocalDeadlineSeconds = duration + metrics_grace. The measurement window ends at that instant; shutdown work after it is not measurement evidence. assess() receives the pair and reports CLEANUP_BEGIN_REFERENCE_MISSING when an overall deadline exists without the cleanup-begin reference, so the previous omission is a code rather than a silent gap.

reference.observedAt: the instant cleanup begins, before manager.close()

normalSiblings.selects: a full run() over injected processes and readers

negativeCases.selects: an overall deadline with no cleanup-begin reference

claims.r6bItem: positive terminal reserve와 overall deadline before/equal/after의 정상 sibling 실현 가능성을 입증하고 모순을 제거한다.
claims.mechanism: The overall deadline (duration + metrics_grace + shutdown_grace) is classified against the observed cleanup begin into three neutral siblings (before/equal/after, epsilon 1e-6). The required reserve sign is declared per sibling (before=positive, equal=zero, after=negative) via terminal_deadline(), so no sibling is both normal and failed and the positive reserve is not demanded of equal/after. The only deadline failure is DEADLINE_OUTCOME_CONTRADICTION: a sibling declared by the caller that the observed reserve sign does not match.

normalSiblings.selects: reserve +20.0 (cleanup begin 2.0 s, overall deadline 22.0 s)
reserve -1.0 (cleanup begin 23.0 s, overall deadline 22.0 s)

negativeCases.selects: declared outcome 'before' with a negative reserve

claims.contradictionRemoved: An unconditional 'terminal reserve must be positive' rule made the equal and after siblings unrealizable (equal forces reserve == 0, after forces reserve < 0). The reserve sign is now a per-sibling declaration and all three siblings are observed as neutral, non-issue outcomes.
